Message.MsgText: The command did not complete successfully. See previous messages or error logs for details.

Explanation.p: One or more errors occurred during the execution of the command.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the previous messages displayed by the tdimigam command, or look at the error logs for more details.

Message.MsgText: Unknown value passed for '-op' option.

Explanation.p: An illegal operation parameter was passed.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the tdimigam command usage for allowed options.

Message.MsgText: Incorrect command usage.

Explanation.p: The tdimigam command was invoked by passing unsupported command line options, or unexpected end of argument list was encountered or there was an incorrect usage of the command line options.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the tdimigam command usage and try invoking the tdisrvctl command with valid arguments.

Message.MsgText: No value specified for option name option.

Explanation.p: The tdimigam command was invoked by passing an option whose value had not been specified. The value is also required.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the tdimigam command usage, and invoke the tdisrvctl command again with the correct option and associated value.

Message.MsgText:
The usage for the command is:
tdimigam -f propfile [-b backfile] [-n newfile] [-v] [-?]
where:
-f propfile The name of the file to migrate
-b backfile Back up the original file with the specified name
-n newfile Name to give the file that is migrated
-v Enable verbose mode
-? Prints this usage statement
Return Code: return code.
Parsing options...
Options Parsed: options.
The operator switch option occurred more than once.

Explanation.p: The tdimigam command was invoked with the same parameter passed more than once. Options can be passed only once. Fox example, the user may have passed the '-b' option twice, which is not allowed.

Message.MsgText: Unknown option operator switch encountered.

Explanation.p: The tdimigam command was invoked with an unknown option.

OperatorResponse.p: See the tdimigam command usage and invoke the command with the allowed options only.

Message.MsgText: Already reached the end of argument list.

Explanation.p: While parsing the arguments, the tdimigam utility encountered an unexpected end of arguments.

OperatorResponse.p: Check the command usage and try again.

Message.MsgText: The operator switch option was not specified. This is a mandatory option.

Explanation.p: The tdimigam command was invoked without specifying the -op option.

OperatorResponse.p: See the tdimigam command usage and invoke the command with the correct and mandatory options specified.

Message.MsgText: Starting file migration...
Unable to perform the migration. Unable to backup the file file name to file name.

Explanation.p: The migration failed because the file to migrate could not be backed up.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the specified file to migrate exists and a can be read and written to. Also, verify you have read permissions on the backup file location.

Message.MsgText: Unable to migrate the file file name. The file does not exist or cannot be read.

Explanation.p: The migration failed because the file to migrate does not exist or could not be read.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the specified file to migrate exists and a can be read and written to. Also, verify you have read permissions on the backup file location.

Message.MsgText: Unable to migrate the file file name. The file specified is not a file.

Explanation.p: The migration failed because the file specified for migration was not a file.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the specified file to migrate exists and is a file that can be read and written to. Also, verify you have read permissions on the backup file location.

Message.MsgText: Unable to migrate the file file name. The file specified cannot be written to.

Explanation.p: The migration failed because the file could not be written to.

OperatorResponse.p: Verify that the specified file to migrate exists and a can be read and written to. Also, verify you have read permissions on the backup file location.

Message.MsgText: Unable to migrate the file file name. The file name of the backup file must not be the same name as the file name.

Explanation.p: The migration failed because the file to migrate and the file to back up are the same.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify a different file names for the file to migrate and the backup file.

Message.MsgText: Unable to migrate the file file name. The file name of the backup file must not be the same name as the new file.

Explanation.p: The migration failed because the new file name and the file to back up are the same.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify a different file names for the file to backup and the new file.

Message.MsgText: Error deleting file: file name.

Explanation.p: The specified file could not be deleted.
